Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with diarrhoea for 3 days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has had diarrhoea for 3 days.
Diarrhoea is associated with abdominal pain.
Stools contain no mucous or blood.
Patient had a single episode of vomiting.
Patient is still able to eat and drink.
Diarrhoea is watery occurring 4–5 times per day, sometimes mixed solid and loose.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Diarrhea like water 4-5 times a day, sometimes a bit of both solid and loose

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient did not eat out prior to illness.
Patient had no recent foreign travel.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of asthma.

Medications.content: Patient uses a yellow inhaler named Lapriso.

Family_History.content: Patient's father died of bowel cancer 10 years ago.
Family_History.source_text: Dad died of bowel cancer 10 years

Physical_Findings.content: No signs of dehydration were found on examination.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised a soft diet starting with crackers, soups, and mashed foods.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Plan : advised soft diet, drink plenty. Start with crackers, soups and mash

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to drink plenty of fluids.
Recommended use of Dioralyte oral rehydration solution.
Patient may progress diet to mashed vegetables after initial soft foods.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Then can build on with mash and vegetable

Plan_of_Care.content: Yogurts were recommended as probiotics to aid gut recovery.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Can use yoghurts as probiotics and will help build the gut

Follow_up_Information.content: If diarrhoea continues for more than a week or blood appears, a stool sample will be required.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If the diarhoea goes on for more than a week or there is blood , we would need a stool sample.

Follow_up_Information.content: If there are more than 8 episodes of diarrhoea and dehydration risk, patient should book an appointment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If there is diarrhea more than 8 episodes, you may get dehydrated please book an appointment.
